usage_note: The execution environment exposes no machine-readable token, credit, cost or quota telemetry for this run; all usage fields are therefore null rather than estimated.
partial_test_invocations_note: Two additional single-file/single-test pytest invocations were run while fixing tests/test_cleaning.py; they are not counted as suite runs.
corrective_iterations_detail: IRLS re-estimated per-type scales during a stiff continuation stage; OIS scale collapsed to the floor and whole tenors (1.5Y/7Y/9Y) were rejected while deposits were ignored -> continuation stages switched to a global scale with Huber weights (numerical inspection).

Huber continuation locked in a front-end misfit (deposits 29bp off) -> continuation abandoned; robust layer redesigned as leave-tenor-out screen + Tukey IRLS from a plain penalised fit (numerical inspection).
Tukey nearly rejected the concordant 1.5Y and 7Y OIS clusters -> tenor-cluster consensus guard (Huber weights for same-sign clusters) and lambda selection rule revisited (numerical inspection).
Schedule convention: initial 'round' rule replaced by 'forward' after a full-pipeline comparison of four rules (empirical model selection).
Uniform roughness penalty (selected by CV) broke the front end under lambda x3 (34bp at 1M) -> maturity-weighted penalty exponent fixed a priori, CV used for lambda only (sensitivity inspection).

Holdout RMSE dominated by one illiquid bond quote (+25bp, 55bp spread) -> precision-weighted RMSE added as the primary comparison metric; leave-tenor-out screen given the same consensus guard; audit-trail wording fixed (self-review of diagnostics).
Single-pass cross-sectional screen missed a second outlier in a 50%-contaminated 2.5Y cluster -> iterated median/MAD screen (numerical inspection).

Failing tests: peer-based scale-defect rule too strict when neighbouring tenors legitimately differ -> tolerance tied to peer dispersion; quadrature test tolerance corrected; report tables allowed to wrap after browser inspection.
major_modelling_decisions: Schedule rule for non-integer tenors chosen empirically: n = round(T*f) level payments from the valuation date with the last at maturity ('forward'); the textbook short-stub rule is ~50bp inconsistent with the 1.25Y/1.5Y OIS quotes and adds a spurious coupon to short-stub bonds.

Baseline = sequential bootstrap over deposit/OIS tenor clusters with linear zero interpolation (bonds unused); advanced = cubic B-spline instantaneous forward with exact integration (positive discount factors under negative rates).
Maturity-weighted second-derivative penalty ((t+0.5)/5.5)^1 fixed a priori for front-end robustness; smoothing parameter chosen at the minimum of maturity-grouped 5-fold CV (lambda = 21.5).

Observation scales from bid/ask half-spread (yield-equivalent for bonds via dollar duration), a 0.5bp floor, liquidity and rule factors; per-type robust MAD scale (floored at 1) so noisy bonds are automatically down-weighted.

Three-layer robust residual treatment: iterated cross-sectional median/MAD screen inside replicated tenors; leave-tenor-out out-of-sample screen for small clusters and bonds; Tukey-biweight IRLS with a tenor-cluster consensus guard (concordant quotes are never rejected wholesale).

Holdout: whole tenor clusters assigned round-robin to folds (no near-duplicate leakage), anchors kept in training, both models refitted per fold; selection on precision-weighted RMSE (advanced 1.89bp vs baseline 2.88bp); time-aware split reported as a secondary check.
Shared cleaning/weights for both models so the comparison isolates the curve-construction choice.

Risk: receiver-fixed DV01 by +/-1bp central differences on the zero curve, tent key-rate bumps (partition of unity), verified against the analytic derivative, a half-step estimate and the key-rate sum.
self_identified_weaknesses: FIXED: per-type scale re-estimation during stiff fits let the model give up on whole instrument classes/tenors.
FIXED: uniform roughness penalty made the front end fragile to the smoothing parameter (34bp at 1M for lambda x3).
FIXED: plain holdout RMSE was dominated by a single 55bp-spread bond quote; precision-weighted metric added.
FIXED: single-pass cross-sectional screen broke down at 50% contamination; iterated.
FIXED: robust rejection could silently discard a concordant tenor (1.5Y, 7Y); consensus guard added to both the LOO screen and the IRLS.

PARTIALLY ADDRESSED: 7Y OIS (three quotes within 0.3bp) remains ~3bp above the smooth curve and the 1.25Y/1.5Y clusters 1-2bp off in opposite directions; kept with bounded weight and disclosed rather than forced.
OPEN: smoothing parameter and (reviewed) penalty exponent were chosen on the same grouped folds used to report holdout numbers, so the advanced holdout figures are mildly optimistic.
OPEN: long-end forward curvature (12Y-30Y) is weakly identified; jackknife shows the 30Y cluster alone moves the curve by up to 3.3bp.
unresolved_limitations: Cash-flow schedule for non-integer tenors is undocumented; chosen by evidence, so convention risk remains for the 1.25Y/1.5Y OIS and short-stub bonds (alternatives quantified in sensitivity.json).
Single curve for all instrument types: no bond-specific credit/liquidity spread; bonds are noise-down-weighted instead.
Extrapolation below 1M and beyond the longest instrument is a flat boundary value, not a forecast.
Hyper-parameters selected on the reporting folds (no nested CV); single-snapshot time-aware split only.
Noise-scale floor (0.5bp) and liquidity mapping are judgement calls, not calibrated from quote history.
